text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Ghh!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...
(UWAAAAAH--!)

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"Reporting results. I have claimed victory
over both McQueen-san and Rice-san."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much...!
And, um... Master...

She then looked over at me with a somewhat helpless expression.
Could something be wrong...?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: If I don't practice self-restraint, I feel as though I might burst into a run this very second.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: "Or, like... something that would make you want to jump around...?"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"Losing control.
Immediate maintenance required."

Seeing Mihono Bourbon looking so flustered,
I couldn't help but chuckle.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...?
I do not understand the intention of your reaction, Master.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Are you "happy"?
I gave a brief explanation that for most Umamusume, winning makes them 'happy' and losing makes them 'frustrated.'

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"Winning brings 'joy', losing brings 'frustration'...
This is new knowledge."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: So this is what it feels like to be "happy."
Mihono Bourbon placed a hand on her chest, as if to make sure.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"Happy" means "pleasant."
No, not just that—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: My desire to "win" is swelling up so much I can barely contain it.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Master, I... desire to battle
even stronger opponents.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
For example...
a battle against Tokai Teio...!

True, the Mihono Bourbon of today
might actually be someone who could give her a run for her money.

Tokai Teio is currently recovering from an injury.
Thinking about which races she might enter once healed—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: So that is... "Mihono Bourbon"...!

And so, the curtains rose on a new battle.
The days of dedicated training
for the "Japan Cup" were about to begin!
